roles.label: Core
roles.description: Balanced reach and an open guard. The base figure for unarmed play.

roles.label: Agent
roles.description: A straight stance and compact arm movement for precise weapon use.

roles.label: Runner
roles.description: Long legs and a short torso. Built to read clearly at speed.

roles.label: Scout
roles.description: A light frame and low ready stance for quick changes of direction.

roles.label: Scrapper
roles.description: A short frame with a low guard and close striking reach.

roles.label: Acrobat
roles.description: A short torso and long arms. Open shapes keep jumps and vaults clear.

roles.label: Staff Adept
roles.description: Long arms and a tall stance for wide weapon arcs.

roles.label: Duelist
roles.description: An offset guard and narrow frame for controlled blade strikes.

roles.label: Heavy
roles.description: A broad stroke, short neck, and planted stance for heavy contact.

roles.label: Worker
roles.description: A sturdy figure with a helmet and wrench for the industrial district.

roles.label: Striker
roles.description: Long lower legs and a raised guard for clear kick poses.

roles.label: Sentinel
roles.description: A wide base and strong forearms support a defensive shield pose.
